# Fixture — the naming authority (F2 landed)

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/lore/calethic-language.md` after PR #133. The body attests the
forms; §7 Session Log records the F2 renames and bolds the retired names, exactly as the real
document does — history, not attestation.

## 2.2 Bound Suffixes

| Suffix | Core meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **-eld** | place, site | *Aetheld* = "compact-ground" |

## 4. Root Dictionary

### 4.1 Metaphysical / The Compact / The Being

| Root | Core meaning | Example derived word |
|---|---|---|
| **veld** | the unconstrained, the void-beyond | *Orveld* (the being's Calethic name) |
| **raeth** | threshold, boundary marker | *Kael-Raeth* (compact's threshold) |
| **gorv** | corrupt ground | *Gorveld* (a root-dictionary example, not a named place) |

### 4.4 Physical / Geographic

| Root | Core meaning | Example derived word |
|---|---|---|
| **vaeld** | proximity, the approach | **Vaelraeth** (approach-threshold) |
| **drak** | stone, unyielding | *Drakeld* (stone-ground) |

## 7. Session Log

| Date | Work |
|---|---|
| 2026-11-20 | F2 rename (card `t_4e58e1ec`): **Orneld** is retired — it stood one letter from *Orveld*, the being's name, which the name check forbids. The Wound's third zone is **Orndaeld**, *orn* + *daeld* ("the remains of the unmaking"). The Tolvaren harbour-master's byname **Gaelraeth** is retired for the same class of fault (one letter from *Kael-Raeth* and *Vaelraeth*); it is now **Gaelrek**, *gael* + *rek*. |
